scope: A final bounded cost-model ablation. No new GPU arms. Keep v2 and v3 unchanged. The v4 estimator uses only the six new calibration starts before any1970/1971/1972 arrival.
reason: P admission waits synchronously for a D reservation ACK, handled between engine.step calls. These waits account for most measured backlogged P gaps. A median with a50ms cutoff can underestimate effective service demand.
definition: For each calibration start take the mean P-ready→next-P-submit gap over already-arrived requests that were not source-window-blocked. Retain long ACK waits. Then take the median of the three start means for each axis.
future_rule: No evaluation arrival/completion enters calibration. No new state-rule equation or SLO tuning.
